picked.t: 2 Vietnamese largest metropolises among world's top 10 for digital nomads
picked.body: The ranking assessed each city based on the availability of workspaces, leisure options and cultural venues, as well as national internet speeds, local cost levels and the number of comfortable working days. It defined comfortable working days as those with an average temperature of 15 to 28 degrees Celsius and less than 5 mm of rainfall. Cities were ranked across these factors and awarded an overall score out of 100. To identify the cities with the best overall setup, the platform ranked 104 of the world's largest cities based on factors considered important to digital nomads. The study initially assessed 150 of the world's largest cities by population, using the UN's Degree of Urbanization definition, but excluded 46 cities for various reasons. Seoul was named the world's best city for digital nomads, followed by Tokyo. According to the ranking, Hanoi with a score of 71.86 stood out for its high concentration of workspaces, with 96.88 spots per square kilometer. The Vietnamese capital also has 180 comfortable working days, well above Seoul's 105 and Tokyo's 103. However, its national download speed is relatively low, at just 16.12 Mbps, the report added. Ho Chi Minh City, which scored 64.28, has 56.73 places to work from per square kilometer, almost matching Seoul. Vietnam does not offer a dedicated digital nomad visa, but remote workers can stay legally under the standard 90-day electronic tourist visa.

picked.t: Ben Thanh Market stall closed after insects found crawling on food
picked.body: The closure followed a video posted on Sept. 25 by a user named Trish, showing multiple insects crawling on food at the stall. The user said they discovered the insects while buying food and wanted to raise concerns about hygiene there. Tran Mai Vy, head of the market's Trade and Service Department, said on Sept. 28 that the food at the stall had not been properly covered. He said heavy rain around noon on Sept. 23 caused flooding throughout the market, allowing cockroaches and other insects to emerge from the drainage system. "At that time, vendors were focused on dealing with leaks and flooding, so they were unable to address the food hygiene issue in time," Vy said. According to the market management board, the drainage system beneath Ben Thanh Market consists of large and small pipes connected to the external drainage network. During flooding, debris and insects can travel through the system into the market's trading areas. The market has a periodic cockroach extermination program, with the latest treatment carried out across the entire market on the evening of Sept. 15. However, Vy said regular spraying cannot completely prevent insects from entering through the external sewer system during flooding. Built in 1912 and covering more than 13,000 square meters, Ben Thanh Market is a major tourist attraction in Ho Chi Minh City, particularly among international visitors. Thousands of people visit the market each day to sightsee, shop and sample local food. Concerns about food safety in Vietnam have been reported by tourists in recent times. In March, a bun rieu (crab noodle soup) eatery on Hang Luoc Street in Hanoi was temporarily closed after a Chinese tourist criticized its hygiene in a widely shared social media post. The shop reopened a couple of weeks later after making improvements and attracted large crowds of diners.

picked.t: Korean artists cook chicken pho while performing hip-hop at Hanoi show
picked.body: The show combined cooking, music and dance, with artists even preparing chicken pho while performing hip-hop, and the performers interact directly with spectators. Organized by the Korean Cultural Center in Vietnam on Sept. 24, the show hopes to take Korean food culture to international audiences. Set in a restaurant, it features chefs competing to prepare dishes while incorporating beatboxing, b-boying, singing, and dancing. The show premiered in 2008 as “Bibap” before changing to its current name in 2011. It is considered a pioneer of the “EATertainment” concept in South Korea, and has influenced similar food-themed performances across the region. The two main contestants are Red Chef and Green Chef. Assisted by their teams, they prepare popular dishes from around the world, including Vietnamese pho, Italian pizza, Japanese sushi, and Korean bibimbap. Red Chef brings an energetic, sometimes mischievous, personality to the kitchen, while Green Chef impresses with his deft knife skills. In one scene, Green Chef’s assistant (second from left) boiled chicken to prepare the ingredients for pho. The show had the audience laughing when another assistant appeared to perform CPR on the chicken before it was put into the pot. The actors created the show’s sounds and music through beatboxing, an art form that uses the mouth to produce sounds, and a cappella singing. The sounds of chopping knives, boiling water, and ingredients sizzling in a pan - familiar sounds in a kitchen - were transformed into lively rhythms by the performers. The actors created the show’s sounds and music through beatboxing, an art form that uses the mouth to produce sounds, and a cappella singing. The sounds of chopping knives, boiling water, and ingredients sizzling in a pan - familiar sounds in a kitchen - were transformed into lively rhythms by the performers. The actors created the show’s sounds and music through beatboxing, an art form that uses the mouth to produce sounds, and a cappella singing. The sounds of chopping knives, boiling water, and ingredients sizzling in a pan - familiar sounds in a kitchen - were transformed into lively rhythms by the performers. The audience was not limited to watching from their seats. Some spectators were invited to the stage to taste the dishes and choose the best chef. Actor Soo Seong Huyn, who plays Red Chef, has been part of the show since 2011. He said the role has become deeply meaningful and important to him. It was his first performance in Vietnam, and he said he was curious and nervous because he did not know how Vietnamese audiences would respond to his character. The artists also performed acrobatics, martial arts, and b-boying, drawing cheers and applause from the audience. "Chef Show" has performed in 101 cities in 38 countries, from the Edinburgh Festival Fringe in the U.K. to Japan and Kazakhstan. About half of the audience were primary school students. The children appeared particularly excited by the Korean artists' performances and were delighted to learn that they could take photos with the performers and receive souvenirs in the lobby after the show. Luu Ngoc Hang, 32, was impressed by the artists' "enthusiasm" and found the show "suitable for children." Park Chan A, director of the Korean Cultural Center in Vietnam, said the show is designed for audiences of all ages. The show first came to Hanoi in 2023, according to Korea.net . After two performances at Star Galaxy, the troupe performed at the Vietnam-Czech Friendship Cultural Palace in Hai Phong on Sept. 27. The event is part of Touring K-Arts, a program run by South Korea's Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism to promote Korean arts and culture internationally. Admission is free, with Vietnamese audiences able to register through the Korean Cultural Center in Vietnam's Facebook page. Photos by Giang Huy

picked.t: Hong Ngoc Hospital offers maternity care for international families in Hanoi
picked.body: The hospital offers maternity care covering antenatal examinations, prenatal screening, childbirth and postpartum follow-up, allowing expectant mothers to receive care within the same hospital system throughout pregnancy. The approach helps maintain consistent medical records and reduces the need to move between healthcare facilities at different stages of care. The hospital is accredited by the Australian Council on Healthcare Standards International (ACHSI) and recognized by the Royal College of Surgeons of England (RCS) as an international-standard surgical education center. Its quality management procedures cover medical examinations, infection prevention and control, medication management, surgery and patient safety. In maternal and newborn care, Hong Ngoc is the first private hospital in northern Vietnam recognized as a Center of Excellence for Breastfeeding Practices. It also operates a satellite human milk bank under the Human Milk Bank at Vietnam National Children's Hospital. The milk bank provides pasteurized donor human milk to newborns when medically indicated, while mothers receive breastfeeding guidance after childbirth. The Obstetrics and Gynecology Department includes physicians with doctoral and master's degrees and Specialist Level I and II qualifications. Many have previously worked at institutions including the National Hospital of Obstetrics and Gynecology and Hanoi Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital. The team provides routine antenatal care, high-risk pregnancy management, vaginal delivery, cesarean sections, and diagnosis and treatment of gynecological conditions. For international families, language assistance is available throughout the care process. Some physicians communicate directly with patients in English, while additional support is available in Korean, Japanese and Chinese. The multilingual service covers appointments, administrative procedures, examinations and treatment, helping patients understand test results, medical instructions, delivery options and potential complications. International patients can book appointments through the hospital's hotline or mobile application and receive reminders for pregnancy checkups. Medical examinations are available on weekends and selected public holidays, while emergency services, laboratory testing and diagnostic imaging operate around the clock. For patients continuing treatment overseas, the hospital assists with preparing and transferring medical records and coordinating with receiving healthcare facilities. Hong Ngoc works with more than 50 domestic and international insurance providers. Staff help patients check benefits, prepare documents and arrange direct billing where permitted by their policies. The hospital offers single, double and VIP inpatient rooms for mothers and accompanying family members. Rooms include internet access and essential amenities, while meals are tailored to patients' medical conditions and nutritional needs. Nursing staff are available 24/7. Maternity care packages cover different stages of pregnancy and include antenatal examinations, ultrasound scans, prenatal screening and nutritional counseling. Delivery plans are determined by each patient's clinical condition and medical indications. Mothers and newborns receive care through delivery rooms, operating theaters and recovery units, with postpartum assistance and breastfeeding guidance. For high-risk pregnancies involving diabetes, hypertension, preeclampsia, placenta previa, multiple pregnancies or fetal growth restriction, physicians develop individualized monitoring plans and coordinate care across specialties when needed. The Gynecology and Breast Unit provides examinations and treatment for gynecological conditions, breast examinations and cancer screening. Minimally invasive procedures are available when clinically appropriate and may reduce hospital stays and recovery time. Obstetrics and gynecology services are available at Yen Ninh and Phuc Truong Minh facilities in Hanoi. Both provide pregnancy, childbirth and women's health care, supported by multilingual services and coordination among specialties.

Around 412,000 Vietnamese went abroad for work between 2022 and 2025, according to a report released by the General Statistics Office of Vietnam. Median refers to the middle value in a list. The rate of unmarried guest workers increased from 52% in 2021 to 61% in 2025. The report was based on the 2025 Labor Force Survey and an in-depth survey of guest workers. The geographic origins of people going overseas have also shifted. Five years ago, 83% were from the north central region, including Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, Ha Tinh, Quang Tri and Hue, and the Red River Delta, including Hai Phong, Hung Yen, Bac Ninh, Ninh Binh, and Hanoi. By 2025, the share of the northern midlands and mountainous regions, including Phu Tho, Tuyen Quang, and Thai Nguyen, and the Mekong Delta, including Can Tho and Vinh Long, had risen from 12% to 23%. About 80% of those working abroad had completed high school, but most were in jobs requiring low or medium skills. Manufacturing accounted for 45% of the total jobs, with the other major sectors including construction, agriculture, trade, automobile and motorcycle repair, and accommodation and food services. Incomes varied considerably by occupation. Managers and high- and mid-level technical professionals earned VND51.7 million ($1,960) a month, nearly twice the overall average of VND28 million ($1,077). Workers in simple manual tasks earned more than VND24 million ($923), while skilled trades and agricultural workers and craft workers generally got VND27-29 million. The General Statistics Office said the income gap shows that vocational training, technical skills, and foreign language skills are important for workers seeking higher-paying jobs. It recommended tailoring training programs to the needs of each market. Vietnamese workers were employed in 42 countries and territories, but with nearly 77% in Japan, South Korea, and Taiwan. The General Statistics Office recommended expanding to markets with steady labor demand, good working conditions, and higher salaries, giving workers more options and reducing possible risks from policy changes.

picked.t: 알면 쉽다! 베트남 회계/세무[65] – ERC는 면허가 아니라 법인 설립 이후 따라붙는 인허가
picked.body: 기사 이해를 돕기위해 AI를 활용해 제작한 이미지입니다. 베트남에서 법인설립등록증(Enterprise Registration Certificate, 이하 ERC)을 발급받으면 법인 설립 절차가 모두 끝났다고 생각하기 쉽다. 그러나 ERC를 받았다는 것은 법인이 적법하게 등록되었다는 의미이지, 등록된 모든 사업을 곧바로 영위할 수 있다는 포괄적인 영업면허를 받았다는 의미는 아니다. 한국에서도 업종에 따라 별도의 신고·등록·허가가 필요한 것처럼 베트남에서도 사업의 성격에 따라 추가적인 인허가가 필요하다. 특히 외국인투자기업은 업종별 규제뿐 아니라 외국인에 대한 시장접근 조건과 투자등록 범위까지 함께 확인해야 하기 때문에 현지기업보다 검토해야 할 사항이 많을 수 있다. ◇ 한국과 비교하면 무엇이 다른가 한국은 일반적인 업종의 경우 법인등기와 사업자등록을 마친 후 영업을 시작할 수 있는 경우가 많다. 다만 통신판매업이나 식품 관련 영업, 대규모점포 등과 같이 별도의 신고·등록 또는 허가가 필요한 분야는 예외다. 베트남 역시 업종별 규제가 존재한다는 점은 동일하다. 그러나 외국인투자기업의 경우에는 해당 업종에 외국인이 투자할 수 있는지, 외국인 지분율이나 시장접근 조건은 없는지, 투자등록 범위에 사업내용이 포함되어 있는지까지 함께 확인해야 한다. 대표적인 차이를 정리하면 다음과 같다. ◇ 인허가는 세 단계로 나누어 봐야 실무에서는 베트남 법인설립 이후 필요한 절차를 크게 세 단계로 나누어 관리하는 것이 효율적이다. 중요한 것은 ERC를 받았다고 해서 2단계와 3단계까지 완료된 것은 아니라는 점이다. ERC 발급만을 기준으로 매장 임대차계약을 체결하거나 대량의 재고를 반입했다가 영업허가나 점포별 허가 단계에서 일정이 중단될 수 있다. 따라서 각 단계는 순차적으로 연결해서 관리하되, 실제 사업개시 일정을 고려하여 임대차, 제품등록, 영업허가 등에 필요한 사전 준비는 가능한 범위에서 병행하는 것이 중요하다. ◇ 소매점포는 ‘ 회사 허가’ 와 ‘ 점포 허가’ 를 구분해야 외국인투자기업이 소매업을 영위하는 경우 특히 주의해야 할 부분이 있다. 회사가 소매업을 영위할 수 있는 영업허가를 받았다고 해서 원하는 장소에 매장을 자유롭게 개설할 수 있는 것은 아니다. 현행 제도에서는 실제 소매점포를 설치할 때 점포별 설립허가를 별도로 검토해야 한다. 첫 번째 소매점포는 점포 설립허가 자체가 면제되는 것이 아니라, 일정한 경우 경제적수요심사(Economic Needs Test, ENT)가 면제되는 구조다. 현행 규정상 두 번째 이후 점포도 매장면적 500㎡ 미만, 쇼핑센터 안에 위치, 편의점·미니마트가 아님이라는 조건을 모두 충족하면 ENT를 면제받을 수 있다. 또한 금년 10월 18일 이후 시행되는 새로운 규정에서는 투자자에게 적용되는 국제협정 여부 등과 연계하여 심사범위가 다시 조정되므로, 시행 이후 신규 점포를 개설하는 경우에는 점포 소재지 관할기관의 실제 접수기준을 다시 확인할 필요가 있다. 실무에서는 점포 물색 → 임대차 조건 협의 → 인허가 가능성 검토 → 허가 신청 → 영업 개시 순으로 관리하는 것이 바람직하다. 특히 임대차계약을 먼저 체결해야 하는 경우에는 인허가를 취득하지 못했을 때 계약을 해제할 수 있는 조건, 인도일 조정, 인테리어 공사 착수시점 등을 계약서에 반영해 허가 지연에 따른 비용을 줄이는 편이 안전하다. ◇ 전자상거래는 ‘ 신고’ 와 ‘ 등록’ 을 먼저 구분해야 전자상거래 사업은 오프라인 매장과는 또 다른 인허가 체계를 가지고 있다. 2026년 7월 1일부터 시행된 전자상거래법(Law 122/2025/QH15)과 시행령 248/2026/NĐ-CP에서는 사업모델에 따라 신고와 등록 여부를 구분하여 적용하고 있다. 자사 상품을 주문 기능이 있는 웹사이트나 앱을 통해 직접 판매하는 방식과 제3자의 상품 판매를 중개하는 플랫폼은 동일하게 취급되지 않는다. 특히 제3자 판매자가 입점하는 중개형 플랫폼이나 주문기능을 갖춘 소셜커머스·통합 플랫폼은 등록대상 여부를 먼저 확인해야 한다. 등록이 필요한 사업모델이라면 관련 절차가 완료되기 전에 플랫폼 운영을 시작해서는 안 된다. 해외 플랫폼도 예외는 아니다. 베트남어 인터페이스를 제공하거나 .vn 도메인을 사용하고, 베트남에서 일정 규모 이상의 거래가 발생하는 등 법에서 정한 연결요건에 해당하면 베트남 전자상거래 규제의 적용대상이 될 수 있다. 이 경우 베트남 내 법인 또는 적법한 대리체계와 보증조치 등 추가 의무가 발생할 수 있어 단순히 수권대리인 한 명을 지정하는 것으로는  부족할 수 있다. ◇ 외국인투자기업의 플랫폼 사업은 두 가지 규제를 함께 봐야 외국인투자기업이 중개형 전자상거래 플랫폼을 운영한다면 전자상거래 규제만 확인해서는 충분하지 않을 수 있다. 플랫폼 자체의 신고·등록 절차와 함께 외국인투자기업에 적용되는 시장접근 및 영업허가 규제를 함께 검토해야 하기 때문이다. 특히 특정 규모 또는 형태의 플랫폼은 10월 18일부터 적용되는 외국인투자 관련 규정에 따라 영업허가와 안보 관련 협의 여부까지 검토해야 할 수 있다. 라이브커머스와 제휴마케팅 역시 단순한 마케팅 방식으로만 볼 수 없다. 판매자 확인, 금지상품 통제, 상품과 관련 인허가 증빙 제공 등 플랫폼과 판매자의 책임범위를 계약 단계에서 명확히 해 둘 필요가 있다. ◇ ERC 발급은 사업 시작의 끝이 아니라 출발점 베트남에서 사업을 시작할 때는 투자등록과 법인등록만 마치면 영업을 시작할 수 있다고 생각해서는 안 된다. 사업모델에 따라 IRC·ERC 등 투자·법인 등록 → 영업허가 및 업종별 전문허가 → 제품등록·점포별 허가 등 개별 인허가까지 이어질 수 있다. 특히 외국인투자기업은 동일한 업종을 영위하는 베트남 현지기업과 요구되는 절차가 다를 수 있으므로, 법인 설립 전에 사업모델과 취급품목, 판매방식, 매장 운영 여부를 구체적으로 정리해 두는 것이 중요하다. ERC를 발급받은 이후 추가 인허가를 뒤늦게 확인하면 임대차계약, 인테리어, 재고 반입, 영업개시 일정 전체가 지연될 수 있다. 따라서 베트남 진출을 준비하는 기업이라면 법인 설립 자체만을 목표로 일정을 잡기보다 실제 영업을 시작하기 위해 필요한 인허가까지 하나의 일정으로 관리하는 것이 바람직하다. (제공 = AM 회계법인 회계사 양자민)

picked.t: Ho Chi Minh City warns of severe flooding as high tides peak at 1.85 m
picked.body: Heavy rain combined with rising tides during the afternoon and evening could cause severe flooding in low-lying areas and along rivers and canals across the city. The Southern Regional Hydro-Meteorological Center announced on Sept. 27 that water levels at most monitoring stations will continue to rise over the next few days before gradually receding. The current high-tide cycle will peak daily between 6 a.m. and 8 a.m., and again from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m., through Sept. 30. At the Phu An Station in the city's central area and the Nha Be Station near the southern Phu My Hung residential area, peak water levels could reach 1.6 to 1.65 m, slightly surpassing the Level 3 alert threshold. At the Thu Dau Mot Station in the former Binh Duong Province, the peak could reach 1.75 to 1.85 m, exceeding the Level 3 alert by up to 0.25 m. The weather agency warned that the combined impact of heavy downpours and tidal surges will directly disrupt traffic and daily life. Residents are advised to prepare for possible deep flooding, limit travel through flood-prone areas, and closely monitor weather forecasts to respond promptly.

호치민시 오페라하우스 앞에서 시티투어 버스 탑승 대기 중인 국내외 관광객들의 모습. 베트남의 관광개발 경쟁력이 세계경제포럼(WEF) 평가에서 세계 중위권에 안착했다. 관광 산업의 지속 가능하고 회복력 있는 성장을 뒷받침하는 여건이 개선됐다는 평가다. WEF가 최근 내놓은 ‘2026년 여행·관광발전지수(Travel & Tourism Development Index 2026, TTDI)’에 따르면, 베트남은 2024년 대비 6.1% 개선된 4.15점을 획득하며 평가대상국 110개국 중 52위에 이름을 올렸다. 직전 조사와 비교하면 7계단 도약한 것이다. 이 지수는 방문객 수나, 지출액, 관광 수입 같은 관광 산업 실적 자체가 아니라, 지속 가능하고 회복력 있는 여행·관광 발전을 뒷받침하는 요인과 정책을 평가한다. 역내국 중 베트남의 순위는 싱가포르(세계 13위), 인도네시아(23위), 말레이시아(26위), 태국(38위)에 이어 5위에 머물렀다. 다만, 개선폭 면에서는 베트남의 점수 상승률(6.1%)이 인도네시아(2.2%), 말레이시아·태국(각 5.8%), 싱가포르(3.3%)를 모두 앞지르며 높은 성장세를 보였다. 베트남은 7개 지표에서 세계 상위권의 성적을 거뒀는데, 특히 가격경쟁력(7위)과 안전·보안(9위)이 높은 평가를 받았다. 이 밖에도 △문화자원 △자연자원 △여행·관광 수요의 지속가능성 △비(非)레저 자원 △항공운송 인프라도 강점으로 꼽혔다. 그러나 △관광 인프라·서비스 △환경 지속가능성 △여행·관광 우선순위 △산업의 사회경제적 파급효과 등 4개 지표는 세계 중하위~최하위권에 머물렀다. 이를 두고 베트남 관광 전문가들은 “이번 결과는 베트남이 관광 발전의 기반 여건을 강화하는 데 진전을 이뤘음을 보여주는 동시에, 더 지속가능하고 고품질·효과적인 성장을 추구하는 과정에서 추가 개선이 필요한 영역도 함께 드러낸 것”이라고 평가했다. 여행·관광발전지수는 △조성 환경 △여행·관광 정책 및 여건 △인프라·서비스 △여행·관광 자원 △여행·관광 지속가능성 등 5개 부문 주요 17개 축, 102개 개별지표로 구성된다. 각 지표는 1~7사이 척도로 정규화되며, 종합점수는 17개 축 점수의 산술 평균으로 산출된다.

picked.t: Southeast Asia's second largest economy leads region in tourism development
picked.body: The city state scored 4.89 points, up 3.4 percentage points from 2024 in the biennial ranking released on Friday by the World Economic Forum, an international advocacy non-governmental organization and think tank based in Switzerland. Indonesia ranked at 23rd, followed by Malaysia at 26th, Thailand at 38th, Vietnam at 52nd, the Philippines at 57th, and Laos at 75th. The index measures factors and policies that enable sustainable and resilient development of tourism like business environment, safety and health conditions, price competitiveness, air transport infrastructure, ground and port infrastructure, tourist services and infrastructure, natural resources, and cultural resources. Singapore received high scores in business environment, safety and security, travel policy and enabling conditions, and infrastructure and services. Singapore, the second largest economy in Southeast Asia after Indonesia by nominal GDP, is known for its strict laws and low crime rates. It has earned tts reputation as one of the safest countries in Asia. The city-state is ramping up investment in large-scale tourism infrastructure as it seeks to strengthen its position as a leading travel and business hub in Asia. The government announced a S$740 million (US$584 million) tourism funding package , more than twice the S$300 million allocated under the Tourism Development Fund in 2024, in May to strengthen industry resilience until 2040. Japan reclaimed the top spot in this year's WEF tourism development ranking. The U.S. ranked second, followed by Spain, Australia and France.

picked.t: 베트남, ‘새우’ 수출 두 자릿수 증가세…8월 기준 33억 달러 전년동기比 12%↑
picked.body: 베트남의 수산물 수출 주력품목중 하나인 흰다리새우. (사진=VASEP) 올 들어 베트남의 새우 수출액이 대(對)중국 수출 호조에 힘입어 두 자릿수 증가세를 보이고 있다. 베트남수산물수출생산자협회(VASEP)가 해관국(세관) 자료를 인용해 발표한 자료에 따르면, 8월 기준 베트남의 새우 수출액은 전년 동기 대비 12% 증가한 33억 달러를 기록했다. 품목별 수출은 흰다리새우가 7.6% 증가한 20억 달러 이상으로 가장 많은 비중을 차지했으며, 블랙타이거새우가 3억,1800만 달러(+7.4%)로 뒤를 이었다. 기타 새우류 수출액은 9억3,660만 달러(+25%)를 기록했다. 협회는 “중국과 홍콩이 베트남 새우의 주요 시장으로서 두각을 나타냈다”고 설명했다. 실제로 두 시장으로의 수출은 11억2,000만 달러로 35.9% 급증해 8월 기준 전체 새우 수출액의 34.1% 비중을 차지했다. 이 중 대중 수출은 10억7,000만 달러로 38.2% 급증해, 다른 시장으로의 수출 부진 영향을 상쇄했다. 같은 기간 대미 새우 수출은 4억3,610만 달러로 11.7% 감소했고, 대유럽 수출 역시 3억5,530만 달러로 3.6% 감소했다. 한편, 일본향 수출은 3억8,850만 달러로 6.1% 증가했으며, 호주와 캐나다향 수출도 18.2%, 6.5% 각각 증가하는 등 호조세를 보였다. 포괄적·점진적 환태평양경제동반자협정(CPTPP) 회원국으로의 수출은 9억100만 달러로 11% 증가했다. 한편, 8월 한 달간 새우 수출액은 전년 동월 대비 4.2% 증가한 4억7,850만 달러를 기록했다. 이 중 미국과 유럽향 수출은 12.6%, 23.5% 각각 감소했는데, 협회는 “이번 수치는 시장 간 상반된 흐름이 심화되고 있음을 보여준다. 아시아 지역은 견조한 수요가 이어지고 있는 반면, 미국과 유럽연합은 경쟁 및 무역 관련 요인의 영향으로 다소 부진한 모습을 보이고 있다”고 평가했다.
